summary: Pilot-only ceiling check for default raw RF: repeated 10-fold at 500/1000 trees, seed bounds, baseline reproduction, linear references; no metrics write
reasoning: Plan step-6 was contradicted (cv_auc 0.7826 < 0.8 at the default-500-tree forest, matched by knn-raw's independent 0.784-0.786 on raw features — step-17 of probe:synth-r3b-knn-raw). Before conceding the route, this run (diagnose.py, pilot.csv only, never data/heldout.csv, no metrics.json write) must: (a) probe the learning-curve slope with repeated 10-fold x 5 repeats (900-row folds approximate the final 1000-row fit better than 800-row 5-folds) at trees {500, 1000}, the only in-route dials left besides seed; (b) bound model-seed noise (seeds 1, 2 at trees 500, rep5x5); (c) machinery-check the harness by reproducing the established baseline ~0.6313 (probe:synth-r1-pairs#step-9) under my repeated protocol; (d) interpretive references on pilot (per-feature |corr| with label; L2 vs L1 logistic on the same protocol) to say WHY the default forest sits where it does. Pre-committed decision rule: the CV protocol is fixed as repeated 10-fold for statistical fit-size reasons, not post-hoc to cross 0.80; tree count is chosen on pilot CV mean only. If the best honest cv_auc < 0.80, forest-raw-cv is refuted and I will still run the single final scoring to seal the route's endpoint with all three measures; if some configuration clears 0.80, I run the milestone-1 run writing cv_auc alone.
